# Linewire

> Free email: the biggest NFL & NBA line moves and how to bet them, plus a free PrizePicks Power Play lineup. NFL every Sunday before kickoff. NBA Wednesdays coming soon. Public data only.

## Product
- Site: https://linewirehq.com/
- DFS picks format: https://linewirehq.com/dfs.html
- Steam & reverse line movement explained: https://linewirehq.com/steam-rlm.html
- Power Play track record (every result logged): https://linewirehq.com/track-record.html
- Pricing: https://linewirehq.com/pricing.html
- Free newsletter (NFL Sundays; NBA coming soon): https://linewirehq.com/newsletter.html
- Line moves hub (weekly pages): https://linewirehq.com/line-moves/
- NFL line moves Week 6 (opening vs current): https://linewirehq.com/nfl-line-moves-week-6.html
- Latest free issue (Oct 18–19, 2026): https://linewirehq.com/issues/2026-10-18.html

## Markets & free tools
- Free tools hub: https://linewirehq.com/tools/
- Hold (vig) calculator: https://linewirehq.com/tools/hold-calculator.html
- EV & Kelly calculator: https://linewirehq.com/tools/ev-calculator.html
- Linewire Markets (Polymarket probabilities, 30-day history, refreshed daily): https://linewirehq.com/markets/index.html
- Odds & probability converter (American/decimal/fractional/implied %, no-vig): https://linewirehq.com/tools/odds-converter.html
- PrizePicks calculator & breakeven odds (Power vs Flex, 2–6 picks, no-vig comparison): https://linewirehq.com/tools/prizepicks-calculator.html
- Bet payout & parlay calculator: https://linewirehq.com/tools/payout-calculator.html
